answers.why: It works, and real homes are heated this way in Odense. But it needs district heating pipes and a cold climate, so most data centres don’t do it: about 1.8% of EU data centres’ heat is reused, and the biggest Nordic scheme hasn’t started taking heat yet.
dontknow: Outside the EU, nobody publishes how much data-centre heat is reused.
